title: Native Sources notifications and cold offline startup
description: Run on the owned iOS simulator and Android emulator, using an isolated authenticated dev stack and the source offline-proof. Set FARMSLOT_HOME, FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PROFILE, FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT for the open browser settings, GATEWAY_PORT, METRO_PORT, FARMSLOT_OFFLINE_PROOF=1 and the owned native device selectors. The cold-start helper checks gateway ownership, restarts the actual native process while offline and always restores the gateway. The owned project must include source proof-pack with a materializable pack; set FARMSLOT_SOURCE_SYNC_RECEIPT to a private receipt evidence file.

proofTargets.claim: A second client pin and unpin update the open production Sources panel through notifications without Refresh.
A new app process with the gateway stopped renders saved Sources with the same observation time and stale age, with all source actions disabled.
A gateway restart retains the saved observation until a current read becomes ready, without replaying a source mutation.
A real pack sync and subsequent node receipt update the mounted Sources panel with a receipt verified after the sync started.
A same-epoch reconnect retains exact stale Sources data and observation time until a current read becomes ready.

settings.intent: Open the real settings Sources panel.

pin.intent: Commit a pin from a second real authenticated client.

pin-visible.intent: Require the native production panel to follow resource.changed without Refresh.

unpin.intent: Commit an unpin through the gateway.

unpin-visible.intent: Require the open native panel to observe the committed main selection.

offline.intent: Cold-start offline, verify retained Sources, then restore the owned gateway.

offline-proof.intent: Require saved data, stale age, disabled actions and recovery without replay.

recovered.intent: Require the recovered panel to remain visible.

capture.intent: Record the actual Sources screen after cold offline recovery.

settings-visible.intent: Sources shows its current selection before an external pin changes it.

details.intent: Open source details before the external mutation updates them.

baseline-main.intent: Establish main before testing the external branch transition.

baseline-visible.intent: The native panel shows main before another client pins test-branch.

pin-capture.intent: Record the native branch observed after the external pin.

sync.intent: Run real pack materialization on the owned node and observe its later receipt.

sync-proof.intent: Require the real endpoint and production-cache assertions to pass.

receipt.intent: Require the native production panel to observe the new node receipt.

receipt-proof.intent: Require the real endpoint and production-cache assertions to pass.

reconnect.intent: Reconnect the actual native client and observe unchanged-epoch stale retention.

reconnect-proof.intent: Require the real endpoint and production-cache assertions to pass.

settings-tab.intent: Select Settings after the device transport opens the app.
